name: SurveyJS AI Form Response Extractor
free_limit: MIT-licensed JavaScript library for extracting structured answers from scanned paper forms, images and PDFs into SurveyJS response schemas using a configured multimodal LLM; no vendor-imposed software usage quota or expiry.
watch_out: Library is free, not a hosted document-processing allowance. Requires a supported multimodal model (OpenAI, Anthropic or self-hosted Ollama); paid model APIs, compute and storage may cost extra. Extraction confidence is not a guarantee; review sensitive or low-confidence responses. SurveyJS Creator is separately commercially licensed for production.
